source: Global Aion 2 stigma rules. The stigma skills and their cost ladder are recovered data: the client catalogue's SkillAcquireData Stigma rows (game-catalog-v2 in the server data bundle, read on 2026-11-09). Shards and slots per level are CANDIDATE (from global guides; Exp.dat is not in the bundle). OURS values fill what neither gives; docs/STIGMAS.md. 'params' is hand-edited; 'generated' is written by `python tools/stigmas.py` from params, tools/data/class-skills.json, tools/data/progression.json and tools/data/dev-menu.json.

params.slot_levels_about: CANDIDATE: global's 4 slots open at levels 22, 27, 32 and 37. Korea has 6; its levels for slots 5 and 6 are not published (OURS 42 and 45). Aion:Stigmas:Slots picks how many are used (4 = global).
params.max_skill_level_about: Recovered data: the Stigma rows stop at skill level 20.
params.costs_about: Recovered data: SkillAcquireData Stigma rows, one ladder for all 117 stigma skills: levels 1-5 cost 1 CostStigmaPoint, 6-10 cost 2, 11-15 cost 4, 16-20 cost 8 (75 for 20). Every level needs character level 22; level 1 also needs AscensionGrade_3 (not enforced: OURS). CostStigmaSuperiorPoint and GainStigmaSuperiorPoint are 0 on every row.
params.shards_about: CANDIDATE: 1 shard per level from 23 to 39 and 2 per level from 40 to 45 (29 from levelling at 45), plus the Ascension quest's shard at 22 (given at level 22: the quest gate is not modelled). Global's other sources (Abyss, Nightmare and Shugo Festival shops, achievements) are not modelled: Aion:Stigmas:ShardRate stands in for them.
params.skill_level_damage_about: OURS: a stigma's damage and heals grow by per_level (1/10000) for each stigma level above 1 (+95% at 20). Global's per-level values and the specialties at 5/10/15/20 are not exported.
params.recovered_about: Recovered data: each class's 13 stigma skills [id, name, NeedCoolTime ms] from SkillAcquireData Stigma rows (all Active, bIsStigmaSkill). The x700000 skill is the class's 120 s Assault stigma. The Brawler's (Fighter) names are '???' in the client. These replace the developer-kit candidates (tools/stigmas.py class_stigmas).
